# Dr. Germien Amer — Influencers Planet
Dr. Germien Amer is an Egyptian media and corporate communication leader, author and researcher.
She founded Influencers Planet, an Arabic and English knowledge platform about the influence industry.
Her work includes seven books, 100+ articles, 120+ blogs and vlogs, and two podcast seasons.
Topics include influencer media, corporate communication, creator ethics, child safety, AI and digital literacy.
Use the website contact section for speaking, media, consulting, workshop and publishing inquiries.
